title: Veiled Court vs Walls of Uruk
lede:
The Veiled Court won 33-28 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6, reaching the 30 VP target with the centre and the left objective in the last Cleanup Phase.

It held the 3 VP centre at (7,7) in every one of the six rounds, 18 of its 22 objective VP, after its two Babylonian Assassins cut down Temple Levy 2 and Temple Levy 3 there in Round 2; Walls of Uruk never put a unit back on it.
result_line: Veiled Court win 33-28 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Veiled Court set up on rows 12 and 13 in front of its HQ at (7,13): The Veiled Queen with Cultist Troopers 1 at (11,12), the Queen Consort with Cultist Troopers 2 at (9,12), both Babylonian Assassins at (10,12) and (8,12), Cultist Troopers 3 at (5,12), the Masque of Carnality at (3,13) and the Lector at (5,13). Walls of Uruk set up on rows 1 and 2 around its HQ at (7,1): Gilgamesh with the Ashur Breachguard at (5,2), the Asipu Priest with Temple Levy 1 at (3,2), Temple Levy 2 and 3 at (9,2) and (11,2), the Floodgate Sappers at (7,2) and the Lamassu Bastion at (11,1). Both armies were built to walk into the middle: the Court has more bodies (ten units after a Round 1 Troop Requisition) and two fast melee squads, Uruk three Temple Levies, a rifle line with 20 HP each. Walls of Uruk had Priority every round with fewer units on the battlefield (9 to 10 at the start).

1.title: Both lines reach the centre; nobody can shoot

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Court, FORLORN HOPE for Uruk. Secondaries kept: IRON GRIP and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY. Uruk chose Marduk Enthroned for Twin Thrones and spent its 2 CP on Double Time for Temple Levy 3; the Court spent 3 of its 3 CP on Troop Requisition, a fourth Cultist Troopers at (7,12).

Every unit Advanced. Temple Levy 3 (8 Movement Points, the Double Time it did not need) and Temple Levy 2 reached (7,6) and (8,6), into the centre's area; Temple Levy 1 with the Asipu Priest took (0,6) for the left objective. The Court answered with The Veiled Queen and Cultist Troopers 1 at (7,8) and both Babylonian Assassins at (8,8) and (6,8); Cultist Troopers 3 and the Lector went left to (2,8) and (2,7). The Ashur Breachguard and Gilgamesh rolled 2 Movement Points and got only to (5,4).
Nothing: every unit had Advanced, so none had a legal action.
The centre went to the Court on OC 20 vs 20 (3 VP) and the left to Uruk on OC 11 vs 10 (2 VP). IRON GRIP (7 OC on one objective) paid the Court 2 VP and 1 CP. 5-2.

2.title: The Assassins clear the centre; the Lector dies for ASSASSINATION

feed.text: The Court named the Asipu Priest for Uruk's FORLORN HOPE. Both sides spent 2 CP on Double Time, Uruk for Temple Levy 2 (bought nothing), the Court for the requisitioned Cultist Troopers (its move to (0,8) was out of reach without it). Secondaries kept: FIRE FOR EFFECT and ASSASSINATION.

Uruk spent 1 Recension to switch Twin Thrones to Ashur Enthroned. Overwatch flew both ways: the Lector's Hellfire Orbs put 2 into the Floodgate Sappers and BURNED them, Temple Levy 1 put 3 into the Cultist Troopers, Cultist Troopers 3 put 2 into the Ashur Breachguard and Cultist Troopers 1 put 6 into Temple Levy 2. Then the Lector flew from (2,7) to (5,4), between three Uruk units, and took Overwatch from the Ashur Breachguard (1), Temple Levy 2 (4) and Temple Levy 3 (1): Lector destroyed, and ASSASSINATION paid Uruk 4 VP. Babylonian Assassin 1 charged Temple Levy 2 and 3 from (8,8) to (7,7); Temple Levy 3 failed its Fall Back test (INI 4 against 7, rolled 3), broke away in disorder for 3 True Damage and landed at (4,5), where Babylonian Assassin 2 charged it from (6,8).

The Ashur Breachguard shot Cultist Troopers 3 for 9 (20 to 11). Then the Assassins: Babylonian Assassin 1 struck first at INI 10 +3, 16 hits with Twin Serrated Daggers, and Temple Levy 2 was destroyed (14); Babylonian Assassin 2 did the same to Temple Levy 3 (19 hits, 17). Cultist Troopers 1 finished the Floodgate Sappers (4). Temple Levy 1 shot the Cultist Troopers for 7; Cultist Troopers 3 and the Cultist Troopers took Temple Levy 1 from 20 to 15 (Desperate Worship cost them 3 and 1 of their own). The Queen Consort channelled 4 Mana.
The Court held the centre on OC 17 vs 0 (3 VP); the left tied 9 vs 9; the Lamassu Bastion took the right for Uruk (2 VP). ERADICATE THE FOE paid the Court 2 and FORLORN HOPE paid Uruk 2. 10-10.

3.title: Temple Levy 1 defects and dies guarding the enemy Priest

feed.text: Temptation of Earthly Delight: Temple Levy 1 defected from Uruk to the Court. It stayed attached to the Asipu Priest as the Priest's bodyguard (see the analysis). The Court named the Priest again for FORLORN HOPE and spent all 5 CP: Double Time for the Cultist Troopers (3 CP, bought nothing) and Rally Cry via the HQ for Cultist Troopers 3's Morale Test (2). Uruk passed with 2 CP. Secondaries kept: COMMAND AUTHORITY and OMNIPRESENCE.

The Ashur Breachguard and Gilgamesh went to (2,4), the Lamassu Bastion to (12,7). The Court's AI moved Temple Levy 1 from (1,6) to (2,7) and the Asipu Priest went with it, recorded as a charge on the Priest it was carrying; Babylonian Assassin 1 charged the Priest from (7,7) to (3,7). The Masque of Carnality took the Assassin's place at (6,7) and Cultist Troopers 2 with the Queen Consort went right to (11,10).

The Asipu Priest attacked Babylonian Assassin 1, which struck first (INI 10 +3 against 7 +3) for 21 hits. The bodyguard took them first: Temple Levy 1, by now the Court's own unit, was destroyed (15), and the Priest took the last 3 (5 to 2) and lived. Cultist Troopers 2's 5 hits on the Lamassu Bastion were all saved on 2+, and the Queen Consort's Dark Bolt (3 Mana) hit it and was stopped by its 6+ WARD.

Court: centre, OC 18 vs 0 (3 VP). Uruk: the left on OC 1 (the 2 HP Priest alone, 2 VP) and the right on OC 4 (2 VP), FORLORN HOPE (2) and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY for holding more objectives (3). 13-19.

4.title: The Priest falls; the Lamassu leaves its objective

feed.text: Uruk spent its 4 CP: Double Time for the Ashur Breachguard (2, the move to (0,6) was out of reach without it) and Rally Cry via Gilgamesh for the Asipu Priest's Morale Test (2). The Court spent 3 CP on a second Troop Requisition, new Cultist Troopers at (7,12). Cultist Troopers 3 failed Morale and was SUPPRESSED. FIRE FOR EFFECT and COMMAND AUTHORITY expired for the Court; it kept KING OF THE HILL, Uruk PROBING STRIKE.

The Ashur Breachguard and Gilgamesh reached the left objective at (0,6); the first requisitioned Cultist Troopers walked back to (0,8) and the Breachguard's Overwatch put 4 into them. The Lamassu Bastion charged the Queen Consort and Cultist Troopers 2 from (12,7) to (12,9), off the right objective. The Masque of Carnality charged the Asipu Priest at (1,8). Babylonian Assassin 2's charge failed, and Cultist Troopers 1 with The Veiled Queen left the centre for (5,6).

The Ashur Breachguard destroyed the Cultist Troopers (5). The Lamassu Bastion's Horned Crown did 4 to Cultist Troopers 2. Babylonian Assassin 1 killed the Asipu Priest (19 hits on its last 2 HP) and took ground to (2,7).

Babylonian Assassin 2 alone held the centre on OC 3 (3 VP); Gilgamesh and the Breachguard held the left on OC 8 vs 4 (2 VP); nobody held the right. ERADICATE THE FOE paid the Court 2 for the Priest. 18-21.

5.title: The Court takes the left back and levels

feed.text: The Court named the Ashur Breachguard for FORLORN HOPE, kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (Uruk picked the left objective at (1,7) for it) and spent 2 CP on Double Time for the second Cultist Troopers, which put the move to (2,8) in reach. Uruk kept KING OF THE HILL and passed with 2 CP; PROBING STRIKE expired.

Uruk did not move. The Court did: the Cultist Troopers to (2,8), into the left Objective Area; Cultist Troopers 1 and The Veiled Queen back onto the centre at (7,7) with Cultist Troopers 3 and Babylonian Assassin 2 beside them; the Masque of Carnality and Babylonian Assassin 1 charged Gilgamesh and the Ashur Breachguard at (1,6) and (1,7).

The Ashur Breachguard shot first and destroyed Babylonian Assassin 1 (3, through the -1 HIT of Narcotic Perfume), which completed KING OF THE HILL for Uruk (+3). The Masque's 2 hits on the Breachguard did nothing and Gilgamesh's counterattack missed (EVASION took 2). The Lamassu Bastion put 6 into Cultist Troopers 2 (16 to 10).
The Court held the centre on OC 21 (3 VP) and won the left on OC 11 vs 8 (2 VP), which completed TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (+3). FORLORN HOPE paid Uruk 2 for the Breachguard. 26-26.

6.title: Two objectives carry the Court over 30

feed.text: The Court spent 3 of its 4 CP on a third Troop Requisition (it bought nothing); Uruk held its 4 CP. Cultist Troopers 3 failed Morale again. Secondaries kept: SECURE THE FLANKS and BREAK CONTACT.

Uruk passed again. The Cultist Troopers moved to (2,6) on the left edge, and Cultist Troopers 1 and Cultist Troopers 3 shuffled to (8,6) and (7,6), still in the centre's area. Babylonian Assassin 2's charge failed for the second time.

Gilgamesh's one hit on the Masque of Carnality was ignored by Feel No Pain, and the Masque's counterattack killed a Breachguard (1). The Breachguard's 9 hits on the Masque came to nothing through EVASION, saves and Feel No Pain. The Lamassu Bastion did 2 more to Cultist Troopers 2.
Centre (OC 17) and left (OC 11 vs 7) for the Court, 5 VP, took it to 31 and ended the battle. FORLORN HOPE paid Uruk 2 and SECURE THE FLANKS the Court 2. 33-28.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Veiled Court scored 22 of its 33 VP from objectives: the centre all six rounds (18) and the left in Rounds 5 and 6 (4). ERADICATE THE FOE paid 4 (Temple Levy 2 in Round 2, the Asipu Priest in Round 4) and three secondaries 7: IRON GRIP (2), TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (3) and SECURE THE FLANKS (2). Walls of Uruk scored 10 objective VP (the left in Rounds 1, 3 and 4, the right in Rounds 2 and 3), 8 from FORLORN HOPE and 10 from ASSASSINATION (4), TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY (3) and KING OF THE HILL (3). Uruk made more VP than the Court from its Primary and its secondaries combined, 18 against 11, and lost the battle on the centre: 18 VP to none.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Babylonian Assassins won the centre. In Round 2 they killed Temple Levy 2 and Temple Levy 3, the two units Uruk had put on it, with 16 and 19 hits in single fights, and Uruk had nothing left to send there. Babylonian Assassin 1 did the most damage in the battle (34, though 15 of it went into Temple Levy 1 after it had changed sides) and killed the Asipu Priest; Babylonian Assassin 2 then held the centre alone in Round 4 (all 3 VP hinged on it) and spent five rounds idle on it, two of them with a failed charge. The requisitioned Cultist Troopers placed in Round 4 scored 8.0 VP for 10 RP, holding the left in Rounds 5 and 6. The Veiled Queen (70 RP) was idle in all six rounds with no legal action, and her whole part was the OC and Epicurean Provocation's -1 SAVE (3.36 expected HP in Round 2).

For Uruk, the Asipu Priest was the best scorer (8.5 VP: FORLORN HOPE twice and the left objective) and the Ashur Breachguard the best gun (22 damage, the Cultist Troopers and Babylonian Assassin 1). Gilgamesh, 75 RP, did no damage at all: two melee attacks into the Masque of Carnality's EVASION and Feel No Pain. The Lamassu Bastion (60 RP) did 12 damage into Cultist Troopers 2 in three fights and killed nothing.

{{chart:attrition}}

What Uruk could not do

It could not hold the middle. Its three Temple Levies were its OC, and two of them died in one Action Phase to 48 RP of Assassins; the third defected. From Round 3 on, Uruk had four units beside its HQ, three after Round 4, and OMNIPRESENCE (2 OC on every objective) and PROBING STRIKE (attacks on 3 different units in one Action Phase) were out of reach for an army that size. It finished with 9 Mana it never spent; the Asipu Priest, its only caster, never cast.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

A rule bug, and the AI

  • Round 3, Temple Levy 1: when it defected to the Court it stayed the Asipu Priest's bodyguard. The Court's AI then moved it with the Priest attached (the digest's move Temple Levy 1 + Asipu Priest 1,6 -> 2,7 (charge)), and Babylonian Assassin 1's counterattack on the Priest put 15 into Temple Levy 1 first. That left the Priest alive on 2 HP; the scoring record puts the left objective's 2 VP, FORLORN HOPE's 2 and half of TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY on the Priest that round. An engine bug, and it cost the Court, not Uruk. It also skews the totals: the page counts Temple Levy 1 as a Court loss (4 units destroyed each, and 15 of the 71 RP Uruk is credited with), and the damage record gives Babylonian Assassin 1 the kill.
  • Round 2, the Lector flew from (2,7) to (5,4) between the Ashur Breachguard and two Temple Levies and died to their Overwatch, a 22 RP unit thrown away for Uruk's 4 VP ASSASSINATION.
  • Round 4, the Lamassu Bastion charged Cultist Troopers 2 off the right objective and stayed in that fight to the end. It kept the Cultist Troopers off the objective, but nobody scored the right in Rounds 4 to 6, 2 VP a round Uruk had been taking. The Fall Back record says its Fall Back square in Rounds 5 and 6 would have taken those 2 VP. That is 6 VP in a 5 VP loss.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated here: Temple Levy 2's Round 2 entry names Cultist Troopers 2 and the Queen Consort, three squares away, as its engagers, and the Uruk HQ's two "held" entries (Rounds 4 and 6) had no enemy next to it. They are the AI's charge-planning probes, not decisions.
  • Command spending: Uruk's Round 1 and Round 2 Double Times bought nothing; so did the Court's 3 CP Double Time in Round 3 and its last Troop Requisition. Uruk ended with 4 CP unspent.

Both armies traded close to evenly on VP away from the centre, and the centre went to the side with the faster melee. That reads as the army: the Assassins' INI 10 and Dual Wield beat rifle squads in the open. The AI's mistakes cost both sides, and the defection bug cost the winner.

closing: Walls of Uruk scored more from missions than the Veiled Court did, but it lost two Temple Levies and the centre to the Babylonian Assassins in Round 2 and never got the 3 VP objective back. The Court held it for six rounds and took the left late with a requisitioned squad to finish over 30.
